title.zh: 1998 年 10 月 27 日发行的硬币
title.en: Coins to Be Issued on 27th October 1998

completenessNote: 该法规为单篇法律文书，无分节结构；正文按官方 front 抬头逐字全录，共 2 条。

text.en:
Currency Act
(Chapter 69)
Pursuant to section 17(5) of the Currency Act, it is hereby notified for general information that the denominations and characteristics of the coins to be issued on 27th October 1998 by the Board of Commissioners of Currency, Singapore, are shown in the Schedule.
